pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions (pyramiding) within 30 minutes of a prior execution or when drawdown exceeds 1.5x ATR.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume and order-book imbalance must exceed 65% in the direction of the trade with 15-second volatility contraction confirmation before execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and trail remaining volume dynamically to target +$20.00 to +$30.00.
